shortDescription: Manages deploy keys for GitHub repositories

options.name: force
options.description: If V(true), forcefully adds the deploy key by deleting any existing deploy key with the same public key or title.

options.name: github_url
options.description: The base URL of the GitHub API.

options.name: key
options.description: The SSH public key to add to the repository as a deploy key.

options.name: name
options.description: The name for the deploy key.

options.name: otp
options.description: The 6 digit One Time Password for 2-Factor Authentication. Required together with O(username) and O(password).

options.name: owner
options.description: The name of the individual account or organization that owns the GitHub repository.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to authenticate with. Alternatively, a personal access token can be used instead of O(username) and O(password) combination.

options.name: read_only
options.description: If V(true), the deploy key is only able to read repository contents. Otherwise, the deploy key is able to read and write.

options.name: repo
options.description: The name of the GitHub repository.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the deploy key.

options.name: token
options.description: The OAuth2 token or personal access token to authenticate with. Mutually exclusive with O(password).

options.name: username
options.description: The username to authenticate with. Should not be set when using personal access token.
